previous.formatted: Error: Undefined constant Twig\Markup::FOO

known_mismatch.reason: The constant test compiles to PHP's constant(), which needs the class: Twig\Markup and Twig\TemplateWrapper exist in PHP (`Undefined constant Twig\Markup::FOO`), but twig-rs's class table lacks them (src/extension/runtime/misc/constants.rs builtin_classes()) and reports `Class "Twig\Markup" not found`. The constant() function (defined()) is unaffected; the twig-fuzz runner registers the classes of data objects, so the bug hides when the data holds a Markup.
